messages.description: First line of the install dialog for an installer that downloads a pinned archive; commands are the commands it provides, version the pinned version
Note in the install dialog of a download installer: the archive is checked against the pinned digest before it is extracted
Heading of the download address and digest in the install dialog of a download installer
Label before one fallback address of the archive in the install dialog; the address follows in a monospaced font
Label before the SHA-256 digest the downloaded archive must have in the install dialog; the hexadecimal digest follows in a monospaced font
Install dialog when the archive could not be downloaded from any address; reason is the underlying error, not translated
Install dialog when the downloaded archive's SHA-256 differs from the pinned one
Install dialog when the downloaded archive could not be extracted safely; reason is the underlying error, not translated

en-US.desktop.plugins.commandInstallDownloadNe: The archive is downloaded from the address below and installed only if its SHA-256 matches the one the plugin pins.
en-US.desktop.plugins.commandInstallChecksumMi: The downloaded archive does not match the SHA-256 the plugin pins. It was discarded without being installed.

zh-CN.desktop.plugins.commandInstallDownloadNe: 将从下面的地址下载压缩包，SHA-256 与插件固定的值一致才会安装。
zh-CN.desktop.plugins.commandInstallChecksumMi: 下载的压缩包与插件固定的 SHA-256 不一致，已丢弃，没有安装。
